using namespace std;

class Task {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, istream& sc, ostream& pw) {
        int n, m;
        sc >> n >> m;
        vector<long> base(32);
        for(int i=0;i<30;i++){
            base[i]=m%n;
            m/=n;
        }
        for(int i=0;i<30;i++){
            if(base[i]<=1){
                continue;
            }
            else if(base[i]==n){
                base[i+1]++;
            }
            else if(base[i]==n-1){
                base[i+1]++;
            }
            else{
                pw << "NO" << endl;
                return;
            }
        }
        pw << "YES" << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    Task solver;
    int t = 1;
    for(int i = 1; i <= t; i++) {
        istream& sc = cin;
        ostream& pw = cout;
        solver.solve(i, sc, pw);
    }
    return 0;
}
